attribute.zhushenspace.strength.desc: Increases attack damage, attack speed, movement speed and knockback resistance.
attribute.zhushenspace.strength.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Strength at 5): +3 Attack Damage per legendary point
attribute.zhushenspace.agility.desc: Increases armor, jump height, safe fall distance; +5% speed in slowed blocks (cobwebs, soul sand) and +10% in liquids per point.
attribute.zhushenspace.agility.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Agility at 5): +1 Armor and +3 Armor Toughness per legendary point
attribute.zhushenspace.endurance.desc: Increases max health and regeneration, extends underwater breathing; negative effect durations reduced by 15% per 5 points.
attribute.zhushenspace.endurance.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Endurance at 5): +1 Max Health per legendary point, food exhaustion progressively reduced (1 pt = 1/1.5, 2 pts = 1/2, and so on)
attribute.zhushenspace.intelligence.desc: Unlocks item usage requirements (feature coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.intelligence.lege: ★ Legendary (requires Intelligence at 5): +4 Experience Dividend per legendary point (coming soon)
attribute.zhushenspace.perception.desc: Reveals enemy weak points: attacks may manifest a yellow weak-point marker on the target (+5% chance per Perception point); only hitting the marker deals 1.5x damage, with a crisp sound and particle feedback; perceives what others cannot (partial features coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.perception.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Perception at 5): +1 Armor Toughness and +20m perception range per legendary point (range coming soon)
attribute.zhushenspace.resolve.desc: Affects SAN value and skill acquisition of various systems (feature coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.resolve.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Resolve at 5): +3 Main Energy Pool capacity per legendary point; hitting enemies restores 25% of damage dealt
attribute.zhushenspace.charm.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Charisma at 5): +1 Gene Lock unlock chance per legendary point (coming soon)
attribute.zhushenspace.operation.desc: Affects skill acquisition, summoning and commanding (feature coming soon).
attribute.zhushenspace.operation.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Operation at 5): +1% Crit Chance per legendary point, crit deals 1.5x damage
attribute.zhushenspace.composure.legend: ★ Legendary (requires Composure at 5): +3 Main Energy Pool capacity per legendary point (stacks with Resolve) and +20% movement speed; standing still or sneaking restores 1 point per second

skill.zhushenspace.athletics.desc: Overall physical conditioning, no passive bonus; unlocks abilities at 3/4/5 points: Self-Protection, Leap, Climb.
skill.zhushenspace.brawl.desc: Unarmed fighting, +1 unarmed attack damage per point; unlocks at 3/4/5 points: Brawl Block, Trip, Charge Attack.
skill.zhushenspace.blade.desc: Cold weapon mastery, +1 cold weapon (swords, axes, tridents, maces and other non-firearm weapons) attack damage per point; unlocks at 3 points: Blade Block.
skill.zhushenspace.craft.desc: Crafting and modifying equipment (no bonus yet).
skill.zhushenspace.occultism.desc: Study of the mysterious, +1 Intelligence per point.
skill.zhushenspace.science.desc: Pursuit of scientific truth, +1 Intelligence per point.
skill.zhushenspace.expression.desc: Expressing and moving others (no bonus yet).
ability.zhushenspace.self_protection.des: Briefly gain armor equal to (Agility + Athletics) points, 5 seconds, 30s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.leap.desc: Greatly boost jump strength by (Strength + Athletics) for a single jump, 8s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.climb.desc: Climb walls for up to (Strength + Athletics) blocks within 8 seconds, 15s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.brawl_block.desc: Briefly gain armor equal to Brawl points, 5 seconds, 20s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.trip.desc: Your next hit knocks the target down (heavy slowness and weakness); flying targets drop instantly, 12s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.charge_attack.desc: For 10 seconds, +1 attack damage per block moved (max 15); consumed on hit, temporarily losing equal armor for 3 seconds, 30s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.blade_block.desc: Briefly gain armor equal to Blade points, 5 seconds, 20s cooldown.

msg.zhushenspace.breath.on: Neili Breath: ON - melee attacks consume 1 Neili for +6 damage
ability.zhushenspace.neili_breath.desc: Auto-toggle: melee attacks (incl. basic) consume 1 Neili for +6 damage. Use again to disable.
ability.zhushenspace.neili_meditate.desc: Stand still for 5s to fully restore Neili (Endurance+Perception), 5min cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_ward_off.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack with +27 damage.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_roll_back.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack, deals extra 21 damage on hit.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_press.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack +6 damage, ignores up to 6 absorption (Spell Pierce).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_push.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack with +9 damage.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_pull.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack, deals 3 severe damage on hit (reduces max health).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_split.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack, suppresses target (Weakness II + Slowness II, 5s).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_elbow.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack +6 armor pierce (scaled by target armor).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_shoulder.desc: Costs 2 Neili: melee brawl attack, knocks target back by damage; wall hit deals severe damage.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_tingjin.desc: Costs 2 Neili: for 10s your attacks deal -20% and you take -20% damage (yield to overcome).
ability.zhushenspace.tc_eight_powers.des: [Passive] All eight jin fused into one. When an unarmed normal attack deals more than 6 damage, it carries ONE jin, cycling in order Ward-off → Roll-back → Squeeze → Press → Pluck → Split → Elbow → Shoulder: +6/+6/+3 damage, Squeeze breaks magic (ignores up to 6 absorption), Pluck cuts vitality, Split suppresses (Weak+Slow), Elbow pierces armor (up to 4), Shoulder knocks into walls (wall hit cuts vitality). Also reduces the Neili cost of the eight moves from 2 to 1.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_yinshou.desc: Costs 3 Neili: enter the luring-hand stance for 1 min. While active, each attack you receive (if the attacker can be precisely located) stacks 1 debuff layer on them (-3 attack/contest, -1 defense per layer), up to your Brawl skill level. Layers last 1 min; re-stacking refreshes.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_lanquewei.desc: Ready stance for 5s: on the first melee attack you receive, skip the to-hit and contest attack power directly (yours counts Brawl skill and the unarmed Tai Chi passive). Win to disarm their main-hand weapon (dropped) and void that attack; resolution costs 3 Neili, 10s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_cloudhands.desc: Ready stance for 5s: on the first melee attack you receive, contest attack power (grapple). Win to reduce that attack's damage by the margin and Slow the attacker (Slowness IV, 3s); resolution costs 3 Neili, 10s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_seabottom.desc: Ready stance for 5s: on a melee attack received or a target moving nearby, contest attack power (trip). Attack-trigger win reduces damage by margin/2; move-trigger win removes their mobility (Slow IV + Weak, 3s); resolution costs 3 Neili, 10s cooldown.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_coilingsilk.desc: [Passive] Your inner force flows endlessly, fine and resilient as silk. While your Neili pool is non-empty, you gain +8 to disarm, grapple, and trip contests.
ability.zhushenspace.tc_dissolve.desc: Ready stance for 5s: on a melee attack received from a target using an energy pool, counter with a brawl attack, then chain one of Grasp-Bird-Tail/Cloud-Hands/Sea-Needle (if learned). If the counter deals damage or the chain succeeds, seal their energy pool for 1 min (no consume/breath); resolution costs 5 Neili, 20s cooldown.
